g.text: 1. User taps Start on the Watch

g.text: 4. Create one session ID, two binary writers,

g.title: phone
g.text: ask the iPhone to start pre-roll and return

g.title: timing
g.text: start gates, buffers, and initial metadata

g.title: sensors
g.text: Callbacks, countdown, and validation now run together

g.title: rates
g.text: Both streams confirm the expected rates

g.title: countdown
g.text: 9. Count down to the planned start
Pre-start samples are rejected by the gates

g.title: accept
g.text: 10. At the planned time, accept samples
and send the iPhone a start marker

g.title: ordered
g.text: 12. One serial queue preserves order, projects
Unix timestamps, and applies each stream's gate

g.title: write
g.text: 14. Append buffered records about once per second
UI preview separately publishes at most 10 times/second

g.title: drain
g.text: 17. Drain the serial queue and force-write

g.title: stop_phone
g.text: 20. Tell the iPhone to stop video

g.title: retained
g.text: 22. Keep local files until each transfer

g.title: failure
g.text: Log the detailed error • stop phone, audio, and motion work
delete incomplete files • show a short status message
